summary: Reviewed the post-merge diff origin/main...cbdca3e — the branch's race fix (exec.Cmd removed from QualityVariant, variantMu-published pid, ffmpegDone reading only exited) as resolved against #498's WaitDelay hardening. Confirmed the merge kept exactly one implementation (grep for pipeStalled/variantWaitDelay returns zero, so git's auto-merged duplicate is gone), that neither parent lost a guarantee, and that all three comments the merge rewrote are true — checking Cmd.ProcessState's assignment at exec.go:934 against awaitGoroutines at :948 rather than re-reading prose. Enumerated every tm.mu/variantMu pair (never held simultaneously), traced all three ffmpegDone call sites and the relaunch/stale-generation window, and confirmed no coverage was lost when the branch's stalled-pipe test was dropped for main's stricter LingeringPipe. All six requested mutants killed, each by a correctly-diagnosing test. Green on the merged tree with real ffmpeg 6.1.1 and AURORA_REQUIRE_MEDIA_TESTS=1: build, vet, go test ./... (29 packages, no skips), -race on streaming and api, -race -count=3 -shuffle=on, and main's source guards. No critical, high or medium findings. One low: waitForExitLocked read v.StderrTail unlocked on its timeout path (pre-existing, test-only, unreachable on a passing run), reproduced by the reviewer as a real race 5/5. HEAD adds exactly that fix, test-only and verbatim as the reviewer prescribed it, matching the sibling waitForFFmpegExit; full suite and -race re-run green after it.
